description: This file contains a test class for the GetModulesMeta API endpoint within the SuiteCRM project. It uses the Codeception testing framework to test that the API returns correct module metadata, specifically validating response codes and JSON content for the 'modules' data.

classes.name: GetModulesMetaCest
classes.description: A test class for API endpoint meta-data retrieval for modules in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test, logs into the API.

methods.name: shouldWork
methods.description: Main test method that sends a GET request to the modules meta endpoint and verifies the response contains expected module data.

methods.name: shouldWorkDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for the 'shouldWork' test, specifying endpoint URL.
